name: Case law: Finland, the Supreme Court (Korkein oikeus)
label: Finland case law (Korkein oikeus)
coverage: 15198 decisions published on finlex.fi, one file and one commit each (Finnish text, and Swedish where published), dated the day given; 4490 citations of law linked to finland-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day the decision was given; for 6864 precedents Finlex gives the year only, and In-force is 31 December of that year (In-force-basis: year only ..., Decided: <year>).

source.publisher: Finlex, Ministry of Justice of Finland
